jobs.occupation: Doctoral Researcher / PhD Candidate (f/m/x) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
We are looking to support our rapidly growing team as soon as possible: Doctoral Researcher / PhD Candidate in Immunotherapy of Viral Infections (f/m/x)

Institute of Virology - Laboratory of Experimental lmmunology
TV-L: 25 h/week (64,94%)
Fixed-term employment for 3 years under the German Academic Fixed-Term Contract Act (WissZeitVG) for the purpose of pursuing a doctoral degree (PhD)
Your salary will be based on TV-L

Your tasks

• Contribute to research projects investigating broadly neutralizing antibodies (bNAbs) to effectively target HIV-1 in vivo
• Design and evaluate AAV-based gene vector strategies for in vivo delivery of bNAb combination therapy
• Establish multispecific antibody-derived protein constructs to target the HIV-1 envelope protein
• Investigate bNAb expression, antibody-mediated virus neutralization in vitro and in vivo, and pathways of viral immune escape
• Plan, perform, and analyze experiments under scientific supervision using state-of-the-art approaches in immunology, virology, and molecular biology
• Establish, optimize, and apply immunological and virological assays, including cell culture, flow cytometry, ELISA, neutralization assays, molecular cloning, and next-generation sequencing
• Perform experiments using infectious viral material in vitro and in vivo (humanized mice) in biosafety level S3 environments
• Collaborate with national and international research partners in an interdisciplinary research environment
• Present research findings at scientific meetings and conferences, and prepare scientific manuscripts
• Maintain detailed experimental records and ensure high standards of scientific quality, reproducibility, and documentation

Your profile

• Excellent university degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in biology, biomedicine, immunology, virology, molecular medicine, or a related life science discipline
• Strong interest in translational research at the interface of immunology, virology, and infectious diseases
• Hands-on experience with immunological and molecular biology methods (e.g., cell culture, flow cytometry, ELISA, PCR, cloning, or sequencing technologies) as well as experience working with small animal models are advantageous
• Willingness to conduct experiments using HIV-1-infected humanized mouse models (existing FELASA certification is beneficial)
• Prior experience in virology, antibody research, B cell biology, or HIV research is beneficial but not required
• Independent, structured, and detail-oriented approach to scientific work based on high personal scientific standards
• High level of motivation to independently address complex scientific questions and develop creative as well as innovative solutions for scientific problems
• Strong teamwork and communication skills, as well as enthusiasm for working in an interdisciplinary and international research environment
• Excellent written and spoken English

Our offer

• Participation in a highly modern and internationally connected research project with strong scientific and societal relevance
• An excellent scientific environment within a dynamic and interdisciplinary team
• Access to state-of-the-art technologies and laboratory infrastructure within the new “Translational Research for Infectious Diseases and Oncology (TRIO)” research center
• Close scientific supervision and support for your professional and personal development
• Opportunities to participate in national and international conferences and to publish scientific findings
• Challenging and diverse responsibilities with a high degree of independence and creative freedom
• For further information, please visit www.klein-lab.de
 
Your future with us

We are one of the leading university hospitals in Germany and network research, teaching and health care at the highest level. That's why many things are a lot bigger for us: the spectrum of exciting development opportunities. The limitless openness with which specialists from all over the world work together here. Or our commitment as an employer to support all employees as best we can in reconciling their job with their goals and life situations.
This is the University Hospital of Cologne: Everything but ordinary.

Your future in detail

We are a dedicated translational research group focused on understanding the fundamentals of human immune responses to viral pathogens and on developing novel strategies for the prevention and treatment of infectious diseases. Our work combines cutting-edge immunology, virology, antibody engineering, and translational research approaches to address clinically relevant questions in viral infections.
This PhD project focuses on the investigation of AAV-based strategies to effectively target HIV-1 using broadly neutralizing antibodies. A central goal of the project is to develop novel approaches for enabling in vivo expression of bNAb combinations that overcome limitations of AAV packaging capacity. The project will involve the design and detailed characterization of multispecific bNAb-derived constructs, the in vivo validation of AAV-mediated protein expression, and the analysis of antiviral activity as well as viral evolution in HIV-1-infected humanized mouse models. The successful candidate will work in a highly collaborative environment with access to state-of-the-art laboratory infrastructure and clinical research networks.
Your work will contribute to a deeper understanding of antibody activity against HIV-1 as well as viral escape mechanisms, and support the development of innovative preventive and therapeutic strategies.
Applications from female candidates are expressly welcome and will be given priority in the event of equal suitability, competence and professional performance. People with disabilities are welcome to apply and will be treated preferentially in the event of equal suitability and qualification.

jobs.occupation: Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) (Geowissenschaftler/in)
jobs.description:
The Friedrich Schiller University Jena is a dynamic and innovation-driven university centrally located in Germany. With a broad range of disciplines, it shapes the future through excellent research and teaching. Its scientific excellence is reflected in the profile areas Light - Life - Liberty, which provide pioneering insights and sustainable solutions for the society of tomorrow. Through close collaborations with leading research institutions, innovative companies, and renowned cultural organizations, it advances interdisciplinary developments. With around 17,000 students and approximately 10,000 employees, it defines Jena as a vibrant, internationally connected city of science and innovation.

The Chair of Applied Geophysics at the Institute for Geosciences seeks the position of a

Doctoral Researcher in Seismology

Commencing at the earliest possible date.
We offer a part-time position (75%, 30 hours per week), limited to 3 years

Our research focuses on applied seismology, with an emphasis on induced seismicity, seismic monitoring, the absorption and scattering of seismic waves, and seismic noise. You will become part of a highly motivated team with a positive working atmosphere. You will support us in our research and make a significant contribution to the success of the applied geophysics team.
Determination of seismic attenuation in shallow subsurface layers using the spectral ratio method, utilising the ICDP Eger borehole seismometers
Calculation of earthquake source spectra, moment magnitude and spectral stress drop using the radiative transfer equation
Determination of frequency-dependent site amplification in the region’s station network
Carrying out 3-D attenuation tomography (t* tomography)
Processing and quality control of seismological data from the ELISE Large-N Experiment and permanent networks
Publication of results in international journals and presentation at conferences
Work on an own scientific qualification project, e.g. doctorate

University degree (Master’s degree) with a focus on geophysics, earth sciences with a specialisation in geophysics, physics or a comparable subject
Good knowledge of digital time-series signal processing
Sound knowledge of at least one programming language (Python, C, Fortran or equivalent)
Knowledge of wave propagation, seismic attenuation or tomography would be desirable
Good written and spoken English
We expect you to be a team player with strong interpersonal skills
Knowledge of German is an advantage, but not essential

An exciting field of employment and autonomous work at one of the largest employers in Thuringia.
You will work within national and international networks alongside renowned universities and research institutions
Participation in international conferences
A Graduate Academy for doctoral candidates and postdocs
Remuneration based on the provisions of the Collective Agreement for the Public Sector of the Federal States (TV-L) at salary scale E13 - depending on the candidate’s personal qualifications-, including a special annual payment in accordance with the collective agreement.
30 days of vacation per calendar year plus two days off on December 24 and 31

The advertised position is offered as a fixed-term position for 3 years.

Candidates with severe disabilities will be given preference in the case of equal qualifications and suitability.

Are you eager to work for us? Then apply by 26.09.2026 using our online form.

For further information on your application and the collection of personal data, please refer to our Privacy Statement for Applicants

jobs.occupation: Biologist (m/w/d) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
We at Yara are part of a global network, collaborating to profitably and responsibly solve some of the world's key challenges - resource scarcity, food insecurity and environmental change.

About the Unit

Within Yara, Crop Nutrition and Biologicals Products R&D leads the development and innovation of our crop nutrition solutions. We generate scientific and agronomic insights through laboratory, greenhouse, and field trials; translate these into product concepts and development projects, and support the wider organization with robust, evidence-based knowledge.

We are seeking a curious, proactive, and impact-driven scientist to advance our product development and innovation pipeline for new fertilizers and sustainable technologies that complement and strengthen Yara’s premium crop nutrition portfolio. This role is an integral member of the Crop Nutrition and Biologicals Products R&D team and reports to the R&D Lead - Premium Products and Organics.

Scientist - Crop Nutrition Products (f/m/d)

Location: Dülmen, NW, DE
Area of Expertise: Research and Technology Product Development
Job Type: Permanent
Work mode (place): On-site + Home office
Job Requisition ID: 24724

Design and coordinate R&D projects focused on developing high-efficiency phosphorous (P) and nitrogen (N) fertilizer product candidates.
Plan, coordinate and execute internal and external research on agronomic efficiency, nutrient release, soil quality and the environmental impact of fertilizer product candidates.
Develop and implement methods to evaluate the mode of action and performance of new crop nutrition products.
Perform screening and proof-of-concept testing for products and technologies originating from scouting activities and third-party collaborations.
Represent Yara at scientific and technical events, industry associations, and forums related to new fertilizer technologies.
Collaborate with the Premium Products and Organics R&D Team and the broader Crop Nutrition and Biologicals Products R&D organization by contributing to additional projects as needed.

Master’s degree plus relevant applied research or industry experience in crop nutrition, soil science, fertilizers, or related fields. A PhD in agronomy, soil science, crop science, plant nutrition, plant physiology or a related discipline is a plus.
Deep understanding of N and P chemistry in soils, nutrient dynamics, and mechanisms of nutrient uptake, transport and assimilation in plants.
Strong scientific grounding in crop nutrition, soil processes, and agronomy, gained through academic research or professional R&D experience.
Knowledge of soil and fertilizer chemistry and plant physiological processes, with the ability to apply these concepts to product development.
Fundamental knowledge of fertilizer products (e.g., soil- and foliar-applied fertilizers, liquids, water-soluble fertilizers, fertigation products, coatings, and seed treatments) and application techniques/equipment.
Hands-on experience conducting laboratory, greenhouse, and/or field experiments, and proficiency in experimental design, analysis and interpretation of complex datasets.
Ability to translate scientific insights into practical recommendations for Yara’s premium crop nutrition products.
Collaborative mindset and ability to work in multidisciplinary and international teams.
Fluency in English; German is a plus.
The position is full-time, permanent, and based in Duelmen, Germany.

As a global organization we actively strive to reflect diversity in society. We therefore encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to creating a work environment that fits gender equality.

Permanent employment contract with industry-standard remuneration
Flexible working options
30 days' vacation entitlement
37.5 hours of basic working time with time recording (flexitime)
Occupational pension scheme (BAV), occupational disability insurance for the chemical industry, accide...

At Innolume, we develop innovative optoelectronic semiconductor technologies that power next-generation communication and sensing applications worldwide.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced Software Engineer (f/m/d) who will work across our locations in Eindhoven and Dortmund and is comfortable traveling regularly between both sites.

In this role, you will modernize our software landscape, develop scalable applications, and connect software with laboratory and manufacturing equipment. Your work will directly support the development and production of cutting-edge photonic semiconductor devices while helping shape the next generation of our digital engineering environment.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and want to see your software making a tangible impact in a high-tech manufacturing environment, we would love to meet you.

• Build scalable desktop applications and software architectures for engineering and manufacturing
• Modernise legacy software applications and migrate existing LabVIEW solutions to sustainable software platforms
• Integrate laboratory instruments, manufacturing equipment, databases, MES and ERP systems
• Develop reliable software interfaces and efficient data pipelines
• Improve software quality, maintainability and performance using modern engineering principles
• Troubleshoot complex software-hardware interactions in close collaboration with engineering teams
• Work closely with Production, Process Engineering, Quality and IT to deliver reliable software solutions
• Contribute to the digital transformation of semiconductor manufacturing

• Several years of professional software development experience

• Solid understanding of software architecture, object-orientated programming and modern software engineering principles
• Experience developing desktop applications

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Fluent English language skills (spoken and written)

• Experience with laboratory automation or industrial software
• Experience integrating laboratory instruments or manufacturing equipment
• Knowledge of MES, ERP or industrial communication interfaces
• Experience migrating legacy software systems
• Familiarity with Industry 4.0, process monitoring, or machine learning
• Experience in the semiconductor industry
